plugin.name: edge-warp
plugin._long: Carry the pointer across a jagged edge between outputs of different sizes, onto the neighbouring output, instead of stopping it where nothing is beyond the edge. Acts only on an edge some output touches; the outer boundary of the layout is left alone.

option.name: enabled
option._long: Carry the pointer across jagged edges. Off, the part of an edge with nothing beyond it is a wall. An option rather than the plugin's presence, so it can change live.

option.name: proportional
option._long: Map the whole edge onto the whole neighbouring edge, so the same fraction along lands at the same fraction on the neighbour. This moves the pointer on the part of the edge that already lines up, too. Only where exactly one output is on that side; otherwise the straight warp applies. Off: straight across, slid to the nearest point of the neighbour.

option.name: inset_px
option._long: Where the nearest point of the neighbour is its end, land this far inside it instead (at most half its length). The end is the neighbour's outer edge, where edge flips, hot corners and an auto-hiding bar trigger; a sideways push should not land on it. 0 lands on the very edge.
